prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity desktop website first-viewport direction exploration, landscape 1536x1024.
Create a polished Dream Clean Housekeeping Co. homepage for a real cleaning business serving Macon and Middle Georgia. The design direction is "Homes, Pieced Together": the visual grammar of hand-pieced domestic quilts translated into a calm, distinctive cleaning website. This is a cleaning business, not a textile or quilting business.
Input image: supplied black-and-white Dream Clean logo with cursive name inside a thought-cloud; use this existing logo compactly in the top-left header.
Composition: flat screenshot of the website, no device or browser chrome. Cream full-width page ground. A slim header with logo, navigation "Home cleaning", "Move-in / Move-out", "Our area", and phone "(678) 232-8614". Below a generously spaced, asymmetrical patchwork hero: large cream typographic panel with the small label "HOUSEKEEPING • MACON & MIDDLE GEORGIA", prominent elegant serif heading "A clean home.\nA calmer day.", readable paragraph "Housekeeping for your home. Move-in and move-out cleaning for apartments and Airbnb properties.", a clear chambray-filled "Request a quote" rectangular button and plain "Call (678) 232-8614" link. Surround this calm introduction with unequal photographic blocks: large sunlit clean living room with sofa and oak coffee table, narrow tidy kitchen photograph, small crisply prepared guest bedroom, and a restrained pale chambray fabric patch. Photo blocks have clean squared boundaries and meet like a considered patchwork, varied sizes and generous air. A few fine black and muted red dashed stitch rules articulate seams; subtle textile texture only in the small chambray patch, not over text or controls. Under the hero a clear cream strip presents two parallel service routes "01  For your home" and "02  For your property" with brief descriptions "Residential housekeeping" and "Apartment & Airbnb move-in / move-out", restrained arrow links. Bottom edge hints at "Tell us what needs cleaning" with plain numbered inquiry steps, never a fake completed booking.
Palette: chambray #d6e2ed, cream #faf6ee, ink black #202020, restrained red stitch accent #ba4b3a. Typography: large editorial serif headline, compact clear sans-serif interface text. Photographs are plausible domestic/property interiors, natural daylight, quietly clean and welcoming. High-end crafted website design, exceptionally legible and restrained, generous margins, no rounded cards or shadows.
Text must make cleaning explicit and show the exact phone number and Request a quote call to action. No invented testimonials, reviews, ratings, awards, guarantees, prices, availability, insurance claims, biographies, or extra services. No literal quilt products, sewing tools or craft store imagery. No stock dashboard UI.
